bear_case.title: Nothing is operating yet
bear_case.description: Oklo and NuScale are valued on promise; neither has an operating power plant. First-of-a-kind builds historically run over budget and schedule (see Vogtle). The TVA/ENTRA1 6 GW NuScale deal still has no public construction timeline.

bear_case.title: Regulatory timelines
bear_case.description: NRC's July 2026 licensing-modernization proposal is a multi-year process (45-day comment period just opened); reform doesn't guarantee faster real-world builds, and slips still reprice stocks hard.

bear_case.title: Competition for the same demand
bear_case.description: Gas turbines, renewables + storage are faster to deploy for data centers; SMRs must win on 2030s economics that are unproven.

bear_case.title: Execution skepticism is already showing up in prices
bear_case.description: OKLO, SMR, and X-Energy each fell ~8-9% on Jul 16, 2026 amid AI-trade profit-taking; Oklo is down ~41% YTD, Truist initiated a Hold, and Goldman cut its NuScale price target from $9 to $6 — investors are demanding proof of execution, not just narrative.

catalysts.title: NRC proposes reactor-licensing overhaul
catalysts.description: Most comprehensive modernization of licensing rules in decades (ADVANCE Act implementation); NRC estimates up to $1.86B in industry/agency savings. 45-day public comment period now open.

catalysts.title: Centrus lands $900M DOE HALEU task order
catalysts.description: Piketon, OH cascade moves from demonstration to commercial-scale HALEU production; DOE options could push total contract value to ~$1.07B.

catalysts.title: Clinch River (GEV/BWRX-300) construction permit recommended
catalysts.description: NRC staff recommended TVA receive a construction permit after safety evaluation — separate from, and ahead of, the TVA/ENTRA1 6 GW NuScale deal.

catalysts.title: Oklo targets first criticality at Groves reactor
catalysts.description: DOE safety/hazard approval cleared; company says construction milestones remain on track for a July criticality target, pending final pre-startup review.

catalysts.title: SMR-stock selloff
catalysts.description: OKLO, SMR, XE and peers fell 8-9% in a day on AI-trade profit-taking and analyst skepticism (Goldman, Truist) about execution timelines.

catalysts.title: Holtec Nuclear files for Nasdaq IPO
catalysts.description: S-1 filed for ticker HNUC; proceeds earmarked for the SMR-300 program — latest entrant in the sector's IPO wave alongside X-energy's April listing.
